osmTags.inscription: Der Stifter dieses Heims evang. prot. Krankenschwestern Karl Walter Rentner hier geb. am 7. Aug. 1857 gest. am 24. Mai 1898 ehrt mit diesem Denkmal die dankbare evang. prot. Kirchengemeinde.
Herrmann Schnellbach 1884-1949 dem Künder von der Burg Reichenstein zum ehrenden Gedenken.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/19354219 historic=yes 0 m from ledger point
site is a collection relation of 727 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (8281 x 12375 m)
present-day buildings capped: kept the 120 nearest the outline centre of 1266 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 581 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
